title: Astra enterprise share, ten days that changed AI, slowdown lawsuit, OpenCodeReview
summary: Four Overheard picks for Sep 20: Reuters on Anthropic weighing a new model as GPT-6 Astra gains enterprise traction; Reuters’ “ten days that changed the course of AI” feature centered on the Astra launch; Fortune on a class action alleging coordinated AI slowdown; InfoQ on Alibaba open-sourcing OpenCodeReview.

sections.heading: Overheard — picks of the day
bullets: Reuters (Sep 19 exclusive): Anthropic is considering releasing a new model as GPT-6 Astra gains enterprise traction — citing Ramp figures of roughly 13% Astra vs ~8% Claude Fable in tracked AI spend, and OpenRouter spend flipping toward OpenAI for the first time in 2.5+ years (figures as reported by Reuters; IPO timing may slip).

Reuters (Sep 19): “Ten days that changed the course of AI” frames the Sep 3 Astra launch as a spark for control concerns, researcher exits, and industry slowdown talk — with Nvidia’s Jensen Huang still dismissing a pause.

Fortune (Sep 19): Class action in N.D. Cal. claims Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, and Google illegally coordinated an AI slowdown after Amodei’s Sep 12 essay — brought on behalf of paid ChatGPT/Claude/Grok/Gemini subscribers (allegations in a filing, not adjudicated findings).

InfoQ (Sep 20): Alibaba open-sources OpenCodeReview — a deterministic harness plus LLM agent for code review, with vendor-claimed better F1 than Claude Code at roughly 1/9 the tokens, plus hooks for Claude Code / Codex / Cursor.

sections.heading: What this week means for operators
bullets: Astra is now a competitive and narrative center of gravity — enterprise share reporting and a major feature both put the Sep 3 launch at the front of the week’s AI politics.
The Fortune suit is a legal counterweight to “slow down for safety” messaging — treat claims as allegations until a court rules.
OpenCodeReview keeps the coding-agent race on the desk: open harness + model, not only closed copilots — another reminder that tooling moves faster than operating maturity.
